_note: Weapon attachments (weapon kit v3). kind optic|light. mount: what the attachment needs on the rifle (rifles.json mounts). optic.type scope = black-tube scope picture (model hidden when fully aimed) | tube_dot / reflex = model stays, the dot is drawn in the lens (collimated, parallax-free) | iron. mag = true magnification vs the 70 deg hip view. light: range_m, angle_deg (full cone), energy, battery_h at 20 C (cold shortens it), offset_mrad = beam off the bore (taped lights are not aligned). mount may be a list (any listed rifle mount fits). kind mount = adapter (gives = the optic mount it provides). kind muzzle = thread devices. fit_min = game minutes to fit/remove; tools = items needed (workbench counts as all tools).

reflex_micro.name: Micro Reflex Sight
reflex_micro.desc: Small open red-dot sight on a rail clamp. Both eyes open, quick on close targets.

reddot_tube.name: Red-Dot Tube Sight
reddot_tube.desc: One-inch red-dot tube on a riser. Parallax-free; the dot sits where the bore points.

scope_4x.name: 4x Hunting Scope
scope_4x.desc: Fixed 4x hunting scope on rings and bases. Duplex reticle.

scope_3_9x.name: 3-9x Variable Scope
scope_3_9x.desc: 3-9x40 hunting scope with first-plane holdover marks for 200/300/400 m.

scope_4_12x.name: 4-12x Long-Range Scope
scope_4_12x.desc: 4-12x50 with an adjustable objective on high rings. Heavy; needs drilled bases.

scope_scout_2x.name: 2x Scout Scope
scope_scout_2x.desc: Long-eye-relief 2x scope for a forward scout rail. Both eyes open.

scout_mount_clamp.name: Clamp-On Scout Mount
scout_mount_clamp.desc: A short rail that clamps over the chamber end of a surplus barrel. No drilling, no gunsmith.

light_clamp.name: Barrel-Clamp Hunting Light
light_clamp.desc: Night hunting light on a barrel clamp. Aligned with the bore. Runs on two cells.

light_taped.name: Taped Flashlight
light_taped.desc: A household flashlight taped under the barrel. Wider, dimmer, not quite on the bore.

muzzle_moderator.name: Sound Moderator
muzzle_moderator.desc: A factory moderator for a threaded muzzle. Takes the crack off a .22; a big rifle is still loud.
